question: What was my biggest purchase last month?
title: The biggest purchase

cells.title: The biggest purchases of the last full month
cells.code:
MON = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]
LBL = {"Housing": "Housing", "Restaurants": "Eating out", "Groceries": "Groceries", "Home & Tech": "Home & tech", "Transportation": "Getting around", "Entertainment": "Fun", "Lifestyle": "Shopping", "Utilities": "Utilities", "Health": "Health", "Travel": "Trips"}
BAS = {"fixed": "Fixed musts", "surprise": "Surprise musts", "everyday": "Everyday"}
last = list(last12)[-1]
mname = MON[int(last[5:]) - 1]
bm = kori.baskets(last)
ONE = {"fixed": "a fixed must", "surprise": "a surprise must", "everyday": "everyday spending"}
d = tx[tx["is_spend"] & (tx["type"] == "purchase") & (tx["month"] == last)].sort_values("spend", ascending=False)
rows = [{"what": str(r.merchant) if isinstance(r.merchant, str) and r.merchant else LBL.get(r.category, r.category), "category": LBL.get(r.category, r.category),
         "basket": BAS.get(r.basket, r.basket), "tone": r.basket, "one": ONE.get(r.basket, ""), "date": str(r.date), "amount": round(float(r.spend), 2)} for r in d.head(6).itertuples()]
emit("month_gen", mname, "text", "The last full month")
emit("month_gen_lc", mname, "text", "The last full month")
emit("month_spend", round(bm["spend"], 2), "eur", "Everything spent in the last full month")
if rows:
    top = rows[0]
    emit("top_amount", top["amount"], "eur", "The biggest purchase")
    emit("top_what", top["what"], "text", "Where")
    emit("top_share", int(round(100 * top["amount"] / bm["spend"])) if bm["spend"] > 0 else 0, "pct", "Share of the month's spending")
    table("biggest", rows, "The biggest purchases in the last full month")
    day = int(top["date"][8:])
    say(f"Your biggest purchase in {mname} was **{eur(top['amount'], True)}** at {top['what']} on {day} {mname}. It counts as {top['one']}.")
